result.summary: The page is largely intact; exclusions for edge-clipped carousel items and bottom viewport cutoff were applied. The main suspicious finding is duplicated restaurant content in the 'Fastest near you' row.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards with the same image, ETA (15–25 min), and delivery fee (€0.90) side by side, which looks like duplicated listing data rather than intentional content.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate restaurant listings server-side or in the UI so the same venue does not appear multiple times in one carousel.
